store_root.description: Root directory where backup data will be stored. Must be owned by the server user.

server_user.description: System user account under which the bbstored service runs.

server_group.description: System group for the server process.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the bbstored daemon.

logging_syslog.description: Whether to send logs to syslog. If false, logging to file must be enabled.

logging_file_enabled.description: Whether to write logs to a file in addition to (or instead of) syslog.

logging_file_path.description: Path to the log file, if file logging is enabled.

logging_level.description: Minimum log level. Options: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

server_address.description: Network address the server binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only, '0.0.0.0' for all).

server_port.description: TCP port the server listens on for client connections.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL for encrypted client connections.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the server SSL certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the server SSL private key file (PEM format).

ssl_ca_file.description: Optional CA certificate file for validating client certificates (PEM format).

password_file.description: Path to the file containing client password hashes (SHA256). Required when auth_method is 'Password'.

require_certificate.description: Whether to require clients to present a certificate (only relevant for auth_method='Certificate').

max_file_length.description: Maximum size (in bytes) allowed for a single file backup (e.g., 10 GB = 10737418240).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

idle_timeout.description: Number of seconds of client inactivity before disconnection.

block_size.description: Block size used for storage indexing. Must be a power of two (e.g., 1024, 4096, 16384).

overhead_factor.description: Extra per-account overhead (in bytes) reserved for metadata and fragmentation.

encryption_enabled.description: Enable server-side encryption of stored backup data at rest.

encryption_cipher.description: Encryption cipher algorithm to use (if encryption is enabled). Supported: AES-256-CBC, AES-128-CBC.

clients.description: List of backup client accounts. Each defines a unique backup client with quota and auth.

name.description: Unique account name (used as section identifier and for client config).

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the account/client.

quota.description: Maximum total backup size (in bytes) allowed for this account. 0 = unlimited.

password_hash.description: SHA256 password hash (hex) for password-based authentication. Generated by `bbackupd --gen-password`.

cert_fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint (hex) of the client’s SSL certificate for certificate-based authentication.

allow_delete.description: Whether this client is allowed to delete backup data (dangerous in production).
